description: This file defines classes and methods for handling iCalendar (ICS) data within an OpenERP/Odoo module, including processing ICS write/read operations and extending CRM case functionality.

classes.name: document_directory_ics_fields
classes.description: Defines mapping between OpenERP fields and ICS tags.

classes.name: document_directory_content
classes.description: Extends content model to handle ICS data processing, including reading and writing ICS data.

classes.name: crm_case
classes.description: Extends CRM case with calendar-specific fields and duration handling.

methods.name: process_write_ics
methods.description: Parses ICS data and updates or creates corresponding records in the database.

methods.name: process_read_ics
methods.description: Generates ICS data from database records for export.

methods.name: on_change_duration
methods.description: Calculates deadline date based on start date and duration.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a CRM case with a new unique code.
